description: Return a bounded category subtree. Use rootCategoryId and maxDepth to avoid loading the entire taxonomy. countryCode is a two-letter ISO country code and languageCode is a two-letter ISO language code; either may use uppercase or lowercase letters. Full locale tags such as en-US are not accepted. Both market fields are required.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market country code; case-insensitive (for example, TH or th).

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code; case-insensitive (for example, en or EN). Do not pass a locale tag.

name: category_get_tree
title: Browse the category tree
